provenance: Owner-reported historical results, also published in the owner's GitHub profile README. Not rerun by the report generator or CI.

accuracy.split_note: The existing HLS guide calls 72.74% validation accuracy. The original comparison.json, evaluated sample count and FP32 checkpoint are not committed; do not label these as a matched official-test-set experiment.

hardware.timing_scope: Start-register write to observed done, including MMIO and polling overhead. Excludes image acquisition and full application preprocessing.
hardware.throughput_note: 34.3 images/s is consistent with reciprocal observed latency, not a separately measured sustained end-to-end camera pipeline rate.

limitations: No training curves or latency distribution can be reconstructed from the committed artifacts.
HLS synthesis estimates are separate from post-route whole-design utilization and board measurements.
Host checks validate integer-logit agreement; they do not execute RTL, program the FPGA or reproduce classification accuracy.
